result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has overlapping text in its metadata line. A few minor issues also exist, such as a delivery-time badge overlapping the food image and the low contrast of some secondary text.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line has two text strings rendered on top of each other. The delivery time ('25–35 min') overlaps the delivery fee ('€0 delivery'), so both are garbled and unreadable. This is inconsistent with the clean layout of the other cards.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout of the metadata row so the time, fee and cuisine are laid out in a single flow (for example a horizontal flex row with separators). Remove any duplicate or absolutely positioned text and make sure the fee is not rendered twice.

issues.description: The secondary gray text ('€0.90 delivery', the metadata line, and the '(500+)' rating count) is light gray on white and has low contrast. The white time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also blend in with the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Add a subtle shadow or border to the time badges so they stay distinct on light images.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card overlaps the edge of the plate illustration, and the overlay badges are placed inconsistently relative to the images. The heart icon on the second popular card is also low-contrast against the brown background.
issues.suggestion: Keep the badges in a consistent position that does not cover the key parts of the image. Give the favorite button a stronger background or contrast.
